item.title: ENHYPEN in Mexico: How to Sign Up for the K-Pop Band’s Official Pop-Up Store, Step By Step
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, K-pop fans! Are you ready for some exciting news? ENHYPEN is bringing a special treat to their fans in Mexico as part of their BLOOD SAGA world tour. Get ready to immerse yourself in an exclusive pop-up store, inspired by the group, where you can snag official merchandise and experience all things ENHYPEN."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The pop-up store will be open to the public from July 2-26 at C. Río Elba #20, Alcaldía Cuauhtémoc, Mexico City. But, here's the catch - you'll need to have a reservation to enter. Don't worry, it's free, but you'll need to book a time slot to avoid the crowds. And, if you're planning to visit, make sure to check out the assigned time slots to ensure a smooth experience."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But that's not all - the pop-up store will also make a stop in Peru from July 1-12, so ENGENEs in Peru, get ready! ENHYPEN's BLOOD SAGA tour is already making waves, with three sold-out shows in Seoul and a highly successful seventh mini-album, THE SIN: VANISH, which debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard 200. The group has been breaking records since their debut in 2020, and their unique concepts have defined their artistic identity."
[Short music transition]
Host: "With JUNGWON, JAY, JAKE, SUNGHOON, SUNOO, and NI-KI, ENHYPEN has quickly risen to global stardom as a powerhouse in K-pop. And, with three albums in the top 10 of the Billboard 200, including MANIFESTO: DAY 1, DARK BLOOD, and ORANGE BLOOD, they're proving to be a force to be reckoned with. Don't miss out on this opportunity to experience ENHYPEN's pop-up store and get ready to rock out with them on July 11, 12, and 14 at the Mexico City Arena!"
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode! If you want to sign up for ENHYPEN's pop-up store in Mexico, check out the details on Eventbrite and get ready for an unforgettable experience!"
